description: This file defines the JsonConfigurationParser class, which provides methods to parse JSON configuration data from streams and strings, handling nested objects and arrays, and converting them into key-value pairs for configuration purposes.

classes.name: JsonConfigurationParser
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for parsing JSON configuration data into key-value pairs, supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations, and handling nested JSON structures.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses JSON data from a stream and returns a dictionary of configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses JSON data from a string and returns a dictionary of configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: ParseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously parses JSON data from a stream and returns a dictionary of configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: ParseStream
methods.description: Internal method that parses JSON from a stream synchronously.

methods.name: ParseDocument
methods.description: Internal method that parses JSON from a string synchronously.

methods.name: ParseStreamAsync
methods.description: Internal method that parses JSON from a stream asynchronously.

methods.name: VisitObjectElement
methods.description: Recursively visits JSON object elements to build configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: VisitArrayElement
methods.description: Visits JSON array elements, handling nested arrays and objects.

methods.name: SetNullIfElementIsEmpty
methods.description: Sets the current key to null if the JSON object or array is empty.

methods.name: VisitValue
methods.description: Processes individual JSON values, handling different JSON token kinds.

methods.name: EnterContext
methods.description: Pushes a new context onto the path stack, used for nested JSON structures.

methods.name: ExitContext
methods.description: Pops the current context from the path stack.
